SEMANTIC_DISTRESS_0_TO_4.itemFormula: identity; never reverse a second time

formula: Sum exactly six semantic distress values

missingPolicy.policy: Any absent, multiple or invalid symptom response makes total and threshold label unavailable. Do not silently fill0, use mode, prorate or impute for an individual's report. Permit skip/exit; missing is not absence of distress.

authorMissingRule: Author FAQ explicitly states no published recommendation prescribing how to handle missing values. It discusses survey-analysis choices rather than a fixed clinical/personal scoring rule.
invalidPolicy: Reject explicit null, booleans, strings, fractions, arrays, out-of-range, unknown item ids, duplicate ids and unknown/mixed input mode. Missing id -> no total. No imputation.
excludedFromSum: All K6+ supplementary questions Q2–Q6 and administrative fields.
report: Continuous total/24 only; no threshold, severity band, norm, diagnosis or suicide-risk inference.
